# oriz Play

> Creative-play studio that runs entirely in your browser: roll story dice, spin a writing-prompt roller, play would-you-rather and this-or-that, then expand any roll into a story seed with AI and share it by link. 100% client-side — no upload, no signup, no tracking.

## App

- [Live app](https://play.oriz.in): the creative-play studio — roll, spin, choose, expand with AI, share by link, all in-browser.
- [llms-full.txt](https://play.oriz.in/llms-full.txt): full plain-text content of the site for LLM ingestion.

## Features

- [Story Dice](https://play.oriz.in): roll 1-9 categorized dice (Character, Setting, Object, Goal, Obstacle, Mood, Twist, Sense, Wildcard) into scene ingredients.
- [Prompt Roller](https://play.oriz.in): recombine fragments into a single-line writing prompt.
- [Would You Rather](https://play.oriz.in): impossible dilemmas to spark a story.
- [This or That](https://play.oriz.in): quickfire either/or picks.
- [Expand with AI](https://play.oriz.in): fuse any roll into a vivid story opening via keyless g4f multi-provider AI.
- [Fresh prompt pack](https://play.oriz.in): generate five brand-new prompts on any theme.
- [Share by link](https://play.oriz.in): copy the result or a compressed permalink that rebuilds the exact roll.
